subject: Intro: Novaforge (sparkbridge referral) — request for short product walkthrough
messages:
From: Anna Park <anna@sparkbridge.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: Trey / Novaforge (self-serve signup)

Hi Jordan & Ben —

Quick intro: Trey Lawson at Novaforge just completed a self-serve sign-up and ran a couple quick evals. SparkBridge recommended Redwood for predictable inference economics and asked me to loop you in so we can move to a short walkthrough and align on SI involvement.

Trey is primarily evaluating latency and footprint for a customer-facing summarization feature. He indicated interest in a ~30 minute live demo + brief architecture/q&a with an SI on the call to validate integration approach.

Trey — Jordan is our regional AE; Ben is the SDR who will own calendar coordination. Marissa is my partner lead and will be on standby to coordinate the SI engineer from SparkBridge.

Quick details from Trey’s sign-up:
- Account: Novaforge (trey@novaforge.com)
- Model workload: short-form summarization, 350–700 tokens typical
- Constraints: must run in us-west region, needs a proof-of-concept by end of June

I’ll leave the scheduling to your team. Attaching a short mutual action plan template you can edit and share.

Attachment: mutual-action-plan.pdf (SparkBridge template)

Thanks,
Anna Park
Partner Lead, SparkBridge Solutions
anna@sparkbridge.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Trey Lawson <trey@novaforge.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: Trey / Novaforge (self-serve signup)

Hi Trey — welcome and great to meet you (virtually)!

I’m Ben on the Redwood team — I help set up the intro/demo and make sure we bring the right folks. Would you be available for a 30 minute walkthrough next week? Below are a few windows (all PT):

- Tue 5/18 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed 5/19 14:00–14:30 PT
- Thu 5/20 09:00–09:30 PT

If none of those work, tell me a couple windows that do and we’ll keep it flexible. We’ll aim to include a Solutions Engineer from Redwood and an SI engineer from SparkBridge.

Also attaching our short demo deck so you have context ahead of time.

Attachment: redwood-demo-deck.pdf

Thanks —
Ben Carter
SDR, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Trey Lawson <trey@novaforge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Anna Park <anna@sparkbridge.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: Trey / Novaforge (self-serve signup)

Thanks Anna — and hi Trey, I’m Jordan. Quick note on who we’ll bring: Soojin Lee (Solutions Eng) will cover integration and latency tuning; Marissa will shepherd the SI handoff.

To make the 30-minute slot productive, agenda proposal:
1) 10m product walkthrough (low-latency serving, routing, deploy modes)
2) 10m brief on your workload + Qs on integration
3) 10m next steps (MAP & who from SparkBridge attends for a PoC)

Ben suggested a few slots — I can take Tue 5/18 10:00 PT or Thu 5/20 09:00 PT. If you prefer afternoon, Wed 5/19 14:00 PT works too but I’d ask Soojin to join at the end of her day.

I’m attaching a starter mutual-action-plan you can edit. If you can confirm a preferred slot, we’ll send a calendar invite (with ics) and include the SparkBridge engineer.

Attachment: mutual-action-plan.pdf

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com

From: Trey Lawson <trey@novaforge.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Anna Park <anna@sparkbridge.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 08:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: Trey / Novaforge (self-serve signup)

Hi Jordan / Ben / Anna — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the materials. I reviewed the deck and the MAP looks straightforward.

Two notes:
1) Our core team is in Central Time (CT) — I’m in CT and would prefer a slot in late morning CT if possible. The Tue 10:00 PT option is 12:00 CT which works fine; Wed 14:00 PT is 16:00 CT (a bit late).
2) SparkBridge asked to have their SI engineer, Mateo, on the call to discuss connector options. Can you confirm Mateo can join?

If Tue 5/18 10:00 PT (12:00 CT) is still available, let’s lock that. If not, Thu 5/20 09:00 PT (11:00 CT) would also work.

Also — small ask: can we add a short pre-demo checklist in the MAP that captures required keys/regions and a sample input shape? I can populate that quickly.

Thanks,
Trey Lawson
Product Manager, Novaforge
trey@novaforge.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Trey Lawson <trey@novaforge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Anna Park <anna@sparkbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: Trey / Novaforge (self-serve signup)

Locked in — Tue 5/18 10:00 PT / 12:00 CT. I’ve sent a calendar invite and attached the ics file here (calendar-invite.ics). Soojin will lead the demo; Mateo from SparkBridge is confirmed to join (Anna copied).

Next steps:
- Trey: please add the sample input shape and region (us-west) to the MAP and share a quick line about expected QPS during the PoC.
- Marissa: please coordinate with SparkBridge on who will own deployment for the PoC and any access needs.
- Ben: please add the HubSpot deal link and mark as Demo Scheduled (deal id RWD-24879).

Attachment: calendar-invite.ics

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the call.

Regards,

Account Executive, Redwood Inference
